correctness.rationale: Equation (1) gives a bijection between representations and bounded partitions with a nonnegative carry index. Independent finite dynamic programming checks all predicted regions for a broad coprime grid. No finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete, all-parameter third Frobenius classification for four-term arithmetic sequences is a natural next multiplicity level beyond the 2017 second-threshold theorem and the 2022 three-generator p-Frobenius work. The residue theorem gives exact exceptional sets and genus, and the maximizer genuinely switches at d=a in the a≡1 mod3 branch. Not a mere reindexing of F_2.
